body.title: Add the path check and the 'paths' failure kind
body.summary: Add the 'paths' kind to ValidationFailure in src/workflow/synthesizer.ts and add checkPathForms(citations, callSites), which checks the ref of code and doc citations and an LLD's call sites by their strings only (accepting the line forms and #anchor, absolute paths and http(s) URLs, refusing prose, whitespace, a leading ./ and .. segments, and naming every offending entry). Call it from validateBodyAndCitations after the boundary and citation checks, reading dataModelChanges[].callSites from the body when present. Added last, after the prompts carry the rule. Leave the daemon correction loop in src/daemon/workflow-rpc.ts and the in-session phase in src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/phases/synthesize.ts unchanged and confirm they handle the new kind.
acceptanceChecks: checkPathForms accepts a relative path with :N, :N-M, :N:C and #anchor, an absolute path and an http(s) URL, and refuses prose, whitespace, a leading ./ and a .. segment, naming each offending entry
Only citations of kind code and doc are checked, and an artifact with no dataModelChanges reads no call sites
validateBodyAndCitations returns the existing boundary and citation results unchanged for a well-formed artifact and a 'paths' failure otherwise
The daemon correction loop still tests only 'boundary', and the in-session phase returns a retryable synthesize-paths error with the entries in its message
